people.name: Arvad
people.line: An island city, known for its skilled mariners and soldiers.

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.
translations.bsb: The men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen. Your men of skill, O Tyre, were there as your captains.
translations.kjv: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
translations.asv: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were thy rowers: thy wise men, O Tyre, were in thee, they were thy pilots.
